en.title: GO-AI Featured at Hong Kong Construction AI Exhibition
en.subtitle: A major local showcase highlighted our multimodal LLM-powered robotic safety dog for autonomous patrol and on-site risk reporting.

zh.title: GO-AI 亮相香港建造業 AI 主題展
zh.subtitle: 本地大型展覽重點展示了我們的多模態 LLM 機器人安全犬，可進行自主巡檢與現場風險報告。

en.summary: CITAC highlighted practical AI ConTech adoption, including multimodal safety inspection workflows for construction environments.
en.articleTitle: BEYOND HUMAN VISION: THE POWER OF MULTIMODAL SAFETY INSPECTIONS
en.articleBody: GO-AI presented how multimodal safety inspection combines robotics, computer vision, and language models to improve site awareness, reduce risk exposure, and support faster reporting for project teams.
en.caption: GO-AI representative presents multimodal safety inspection capabilities at the CITAC CIC HK themed event.
en.imageAlt: GO-AI representative speaking at CITAC event

zh.summary: CITAC 強調 AI ConTech 的實際落地，其中包括面向建造環境的多模態安全巡檢流程。
zh.articleTitle: 超越人類視覺：多模態安全巡檢的力量
zh.articleBody: GO-AI 展示了如何結合機器人、電腦視覺與語言模型，提升工地現場感知、降低風險暴露，並加快團隊報告流程。
zh.caption: GO-AI 代表於 CITAC CIC HK 主題活動中介紹多模態安全巡檢能力。
zh.imageAlt: GO-AI 代表於 CITAC 活動發表演講

en.summary: GO-AI was featured for practical AI patrol robotics that improve construction site safety and reduce manpower in hazardous zones.
en.articleBody: At the CITAC themed exhibition, GO-AI demonstrated autonomous inspection workflows with real-time data collection and customizable AI-generated reports to support safer decision-making on construction sites.
en.caption: Evelyn Tandiono, AI Programmer at GO-AI, demonstrates the multimodal LLM-powered robotic safety dog for autonomous site patrols.
en.imageAlt: Evelyn Tandiono with GO-AI robotic safety dog at exhibition

zh.summary: GO-AI 因可落地的 AI 巡檢機器人方案而受關注，能提升工地安全並降低高風險區域的人力投入。
zh.articleTitle: AI 巡檢機器人實現 360 度檢查
zh.articleBody: 在 CITAC 主題展中，GO-AI 展示了自主巡檢流程：即時資料採集與可自訂 AI 報告，協助施工現場更安全地做出決策。
zh.caption: GO-AI AI 程式工程師 Evelyn Tandiono 現場展示多模態 LLM 機器人安全犬，用於自主巡檢。
zh.imageAlt: Evelyn Tandiono 與 GO-AI 機器人安全犬於展會現場
